items.text: In this same slice run scripts/swift-test --package-path ios/DSHKit on Mac and scripts/xc build -destination 'generic/platform=iOS Simulator'. Core and DSHPlatform build for macOS 15 without depending on DSHFeatures; AVAudioSession and SpeechAnalyzer stay in the iOS 26 adapter.

Verify permission, dictation and draft composition through the injected Transcriber and the voice demo. Verify Markdown tables and CJK emphasis in shared rendering, and restore the lock-screen activity through the existing Markdown and Live Activity tests/demos.
Widget links only DSHActivity among project products. Move debug arguments/factories to DSHTestSupport with Debug-only app composition and pass scripts/check-release-clean on actual products.

Record TaskStore's production, test and documented external callers. If only tests require it, move the legacy client there. If an external API is promised, retain a separate compatibility product with a migration path. Verify the chosen callers compile without a Core-to-Features edge.
